# Grok Bot skills

> Free Grok Bot and AI agent SKILL.md templates with standing safety rules, plus paid skill packs for a multi-bot fleet, reminders, a credit coach, a project sprint, and a domain and SEO launch.

A skill is an instruction file a Grok Bot or similar AI assistant follows. The free skills in https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills are MIT-licensed. Paid packs are sold separately on Gumroad under their own terms.

## Start here

- [Grok Bot Skills: The Complete Guide](https://skillsforbots.com/grok-bot-skills/): What a Grok Bot skill is, skills vs routines, where skills live and how a bot finds them, three ways to get a skill into Grok Bot, how to write one, the safety rules every skill should carry, free skills, paid packs, fixes, and an FAQ. Checked against the Grok Bot docs on November 24, 2026.

- [What are agent skills? A plain-English guide for bot owners](https://skillsforbots.com/agent-skills/): What a SKILL.md skill is, what's inside one, how bots load skills, how skills differ from prompts, routines, MCP and AGENTS.md, which tools read them, and a five-step safety check before installing one.
- [Grok Bot Skill Template: Annotated SKILL.md You Can Copy](https://skillsforbots.com/skill-md/template/): A free, annotated SKILL.md template for Grok Bot skills: name and description, when to use it, steps, an ask-before-acting section, and a disclaimer. Copy it and fill the brackets.
- [Free Grok Bot Skill Checker: SKILL.md Format and Safety](https://skillsforbots.com/tools/skill-md-checker/): Paste a Grok Bot SKILL.md and check its frontmatter, name, description, length, safety rules, disclaimer, risky wording, hidden text, and links. Runs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

## Free skills

- [Bot Safety Rules Starter](https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills/blob/main/skills/bot-safety-rules-starter/SKILL.md): Standing rules that no bot sends email or messages without owner approval, no bot spends money, and a one-time approval is not a standing waiver, plus a blank structured handoff note.
- Also on Agensi: [Bot Safety Rules Starter](https://www.agensi.io/skills/bot-safety-rules-starter)
- [Reminder Basics](https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills/blob/main/skills/reminder-basics/SKILL.md): One reminder that repeats daily until the owner clearly says it is done. Free, limited version of Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders (one item, one daily time).
- Also on Agensi: [Reminder Basics](https://www.agensi.io/skills/reminder-basics)
- [Usage Reset Sprint](https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills/blob/main/skills/usage-reset-sprint/SKILL.md): Use leftover usage on a project right before a usage or token limit resets: check remaining usage and the reset time, finish the highest-value chunk that fits, and leave a handoff so work can resume after the reset. Does not buy credits or spend money to get more usage. Free, limited version of Project Sprint (one window, one handoff).
- Also on Agensi: [Usage Reset Sprint](https://www.agensi.io/skills/usage-reset-sprint)

## Premium packs

- [Bot Fleet Coordinator](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/ergple): $12. A primary bot that routes each task to the right specialist, writes a handoff note, and follows no-send / no-spend rules.
- Also on Agensi: [Bot Fleet Coordinator](https://www.agensi.io/skills/bot-fleet-coordinator)
- [Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/hdqoqb): $9. Reminders that keep coming back until you clearly say an item is done.
- Also on Agensi: [Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders](https://www.agensi.io/skills/nag-until-cleared-reminders)
- [Credit Repair Coach](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/ifujn): $12. Educational daily or on-demand credit briefs with today's top 3 actions, labeled estimates, and letter drafts you send yourself. Not financial or legal advice; no results promised.
- Also on Agensi: [Credit Repair Coach](https://www.agensi.io/skills/credit-repair-coach)
- [Project Sprint](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/project-sprint): $19. Plan a project across several usage windows, finish a high-value chunk before each reset, and pick up from a handoff after, without buying more credits.
- Also on Agensi: [Project Sprint](https://www.agensi.io/skills/project-sprint)
- [Domain + SEO Launch Playbook](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/domain-seo-launch): $19. One skill that walks your bot through moving a static site to a custom domain and launching it for search, in 8 phases, with a check after each one.
- Also on Agensi: [Domain + SEO Launch Playbook](https://www.agensi.io/skills/domain-seo-launch-playbook)
- [Bot Owner Starter Bundle](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/vxecie): $19. The Bot Fleet Coordinator, Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders, and Credit Repair Coach in one download (saves $14 vs $33 separately).
- Also on Agensi: [Bot Owner Starter Bundle](https://www.agensi.io/bundles/bot-owner-starter-bundle)

## Guides

- [Grok Bot Skills Guides: Install, Write, Safety, Routines](https://skillsforbots.com/guides/): Every Skills for Bots guide in one place: what Grok Bot skills are, how to install and write them, safety and approval rules, routines, reminders, and usage.

- [How to Stop Grok Bot From Spending Money (Without Breaking It)](https://skillsforbots.com/how-to-stop-ai-bot-spending-money/): Practical steps to keep your Grok Bot from buying, subscribing, or paying without your OK: platform limits, card hygiene, and a no-spend rule it follows.
- [Grok Bot Reminders That Repeat Until You’re Done](https://skillsforbots.com/ai-bot-reminders-that-dont-stop/): Set up a Grok Bot reminder that repeats until you clearly say a task is done, not when a date passes or you reply ok. Rules, wording, and routine setup.
- [How to Coordinate Multiple Grok Bots Without Losing Track](https://skillsforbots.com/coordinate-multiple-ai-bots/): Running several Grok Bots? Give each one a lane, route work through one coordinator, and use a handoff note so context and approvals don’t get lost.
- [How to Make Grok Bot Ask Before It Acts](https://skillsforbots.com/ai-bot-ask-before-acting/): Set a standing rule so your Grok Bot drafts emails, posts, and purchases, then waits for a clear yes. One-time approval stays one-time.
- [How to Get a Daily Credit Action Plan From Grok Bot](https://skillsforbots.com/ai-bot-daily-credit-action-plan/): Use Grok Bot for a short daily credit brief: today’s top 3 actions, figures labeled as estimates, and letter drafts you send yourself. Educational only; no results promised.
- [How to Add a Skill to Grok Bot (and Make It Stick)](https://skillsforbots.com/how-to-add-a-skill-to-your-ai-bot/): A skill is a SKILL.md file of standing instructions your Grok Bot follows on later runs. Fill in the placeholders, save it as a private skill, and test it.
- [How to Make Grok Bot Use Remaining Usage Before It Resets](https://skillsforbots.com/ai-bot-use-remaining-usage-before-reset/): Have your Grok Bot check remaining usage, finish the highest-value chunk that fits, and leave a handoff so work continues after the limit resets, without buying more credits.

## Install a skill

- [How to Add a Skill to Any AI Bot](https://skillsforbots.com/install/): How to install an agent skill in any AI bot: five steps that work everywhere, and where Grok Bot, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and Cursor take skills.
- [How to Install Grok Bot Skills From GitHub (3 Ways)](https://skillsforbots.com/install/grok-bot/): Three ways to install a Grok Bot skill from GitHub: paste the SKILL.md, give the bot the repo link, or copy the folder. Plus how to check it loaded.

## Safety and approvals

- [How to Check a Grok Bot Skill Is Safe Before You Install It](https://skillsforbots.com/safety/check-a-skill-before-installing/): An 8-step check before you install a skill in Grok Bot: risky actions, hidden text, scripts, data access, and a safe first test.
- [Grok Bot Approval Rules: A No-Send, No-Spend Template](https://skillsforbots.com/safety/approval-rules/): A copy-paste approval rules template for Grok Bot: what needs a yes, what the bot must show you, what counts as approval, and how to test it.

## Compare

- [Agent Skills vs MCP Servers: What Each One Does](https://skillsforbots.com/compare/skills-vs-mcp/): Agent skills teach an AI bot how to do a job. MCP servers connect it to tools and data. A plain comparison, when you need each, and how they work together.
- [Grok Bot Skills vs Routines: The How and the When](https://skillsforbots.com/routines/skills-vs-scheduled-tasks/): A skill tells your Grok Bot how to do a job. A routine tells it when. How the two fit together in Grok Bot, with two worked examples.

## Roundups

- [Grok Bot Skills on GitHub: The Free Repos Worth Knowing](https://skillsforbots.com/skills/grok-bot-skills-github/): An honest list of free Grok Bot skill repos on GitHub: what each one is for, how it installs, and its license, read from each repo on Nov 23, 2026.
- [Best Grok Bot Skills for Everyday Life Admin (Free and Paid)](https://skillsforbots.com/skills/everyday/): Grok Bot skills for everyday life admin, not code: safety rules, reminders, daily plans, usage resets, and shopping decisions. Free and paid, mine and others’.
